patch_description: Insert a lightweight mid-circuit RZ rotation layer between the RX rotations (Layer 3) and the skip/diameter entangling blocks. The RZ parameters are tied in mirror pairs across the qubit register (wire 0 with wire 7, wire 1 with wire 6, etc.), so only 4 unique parameters are added regardless of qubit count. This introduces structured phase control that can sharpen local expressivity (by giving each qubit an extra rotation axis right before the longer-range entangling gates) while keeping the parameter count essentially unchanged, since the mirror-sharing trick reuses the "shared depth" regularization idea that has previously improved generalization gap and test accuracy in this ansatz family. The expectation is a modest boost in validation/test accuracy and possibly faster convergence, without the parameter-count blow-up that a fully independent RZ layer would cause.
